name: client_connection_check_interval
description: Sets the time interval between checks for client disconnection while a query is running.
symptoms: Delayed detection of dead clients during long-running queries
Unnecessary CPU overhead from overly frequent checks
tuning_tips: Set to a low value (e.g., 100–1000 ms) if fast client failure detection is critical; increase (or set to 0 to disable) to reduce CPU overhead in high-throughput, low-latency environments with reliable networks.
